name: GlobalSecureAccessM365Profile
label: Manage the Microsoft 365 traffic forwarding profile
helpText: Chooses who gets their Microsoft 365 traffic (Exchange, SharePoint, Teams) sent through Global Secure Access on devices with the client installed: all users, or selected groups for a pilot. Groups assigned by hand are left alone. Don't set this to Disabled while 'Require a compliant network (Global Secure Access)' is enabled - they will keep flipping each other. Requires 'Onboard Global Secure Access' first.
executiveText: Controls which staff have Microsoft 365 traffic routed through the company's network security service on managed devices: everyone, or a pilot group first.
docsDescription: Checks the Microsoft 365 traffic profile: on or off, its policy links, and who it is assigned to. Sets the profile state, enables any disabled policy links, and assigns all users or the selected groups. Users, groups and devices assigned by hand are kept.

assignedGroups.label: Group names to assign the profile to (when 'Selected groups' is chosen)
